name: Question 7
problem:
A rectangular plate of mass $M$ and uniform mass density occupies the region
$D={(x,y)\,:\,-1\le x\le 2,\,\,0\le y\le 2}.$
Find the moment of inertia of this plate about the line $x=-1.$
worked_solution:
The moment of inertia of a plane lamina in the shape of a region $D$ about an axis of rotation $l$ is given by

$$
{I}_{l}={∬}_{D}\lambda (x,y)[r(x,y)]^{2}\,\text{d}A,
$$

where $\lambda (x,y)$ is the mass density function of the lamina, and $r(x,y)$ is the distance from the line $l$ to the point $(x,y)$ on $D.$

First, the distance between a point on $D$ and the line $x=-1$ is given by

$$
r(x,y)=|x+1|.
$$

Next, the area of the rectangular plate $D$ is $A=3\cdot 2=6.$ Since the plate has uniform density, the mass density function is given by

$$
\lambda (x,y)=\frac{M}{A}=\frac{M}{6}.
$$

Therefore, the moment of inertia about the line $x=-1$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{I}_{l} & ={∬}_{D}\lambda (x,y)[r(x,y)]^{2}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{-1}^{2}\frac{M}{6}|x+1{|}^{2}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{-1}^{2}\frac{M}{6}(x+1)^{2}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{M}{6}({\int }_{-1}^{2}(x+1)^{2}\,\text{d}x)({\int }_{0}^{2}\,\text{d}y) \\  & =\frac{M}{6}\cdot [\frac{1}{3}(x+1)^{3}]_{-1}^{2}\cdot [y]_{0}^{2} \\  & =\frac{M}{6}(\frac{1}{3}(2+1)^{3}-\frac{1}{3}(-1+1)^{3})\cdot (2-0) \\  & =\frac{M}{6}(9-0)\cdot 2 \\  & =3M.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 7
?

A rectangular plate of mass M and uniform mass density occupies the region D={(x,y):−1≤x≤2,0≤y≤2}. Find the moment of inertia of this plate about the line x=−1.

a
4M
b
3M
c
2M
d
M
e
5M
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The moment of inertia of a plane lamina in the shape of a region D about an axis of rotation l is given by

Il=∬Dλ(x,y)[r(x,y)]2dA,

where λ(x,y) is the mass density function of the lamina, and r(x,y) is the distance from the line l to the point (x,y) on D.

First, the distance between a point on D and the line x=−1 is given by

r(x,y)=|x+1|.

Next, the area of the rectangular plate D is A=3⋅2=6. Since the plate has uniform density, the mass density function is given by λ(x,y)=MA=M6.

Therefore, the moment of inertia about the line x=−1 is

Il=∬Dλ(x,y)[r(x,y)]2dA=∫02∫−12M6|x+1|2dxdy=∫02∫−12M6(x+1)2dxdy=M6(∫−12(x+1)2dx)(∫02dy)=M6⋅[13(x+1)3]−12⋅[y]02=M6(13(2+1)3−13(−1+1)3)⋅(2−0)=M6(9−0)⋅2=3M.
